# 303box

> 303box is a free browser-based 16-step acid bassline pattern generator inspired by TB-303 and TD-3 sequencing workflows.

Canonical URL: https://303box.com/

## Core capabilities
- Program 16 sequencing steps.
- Set note pitch, octave down/up, accent, slide, trigger, tie and rest states.
- Choose sawtooth or square waveform.
- Adjust tempo from 50 to 250 BPM with a hardware-style knob and seven-segment display.
- Adjust cutoff, resonance, envelope modulation, decay and accent.
- Preview patterns with the Web Audio API.
- Export the complete pattern sheet as a JPG.
- Store the current working session locally in the browser.

## Languages
- English
- Turkish
